title: Across the Divide
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: tense combined-arms cinematic underscore, modern hybrid orchestra, pulsing synth ostinato, timpani hits, a bold low brass theme, builds steadily, no vocals

shots.prompt: A fortified far shore across a narrow sea strait seen through morning haze: bunkers, radar domes and three tall drone uplink masts with blinking lights on the hills, patrol boats on the water, menacing.
shots.line: Orion Group holds the far shore.

shots.prompt: Turn this top-down game map into a glowing holographic tactical map projected on a dark command table, seen at a slight angle. Keep the terrain layout, coastline and roads of the reference. Add three red uplink markers, a blue relay icon, gold dashed crossing routes over the water, teal and amber light.
shots.line: Three drone uplinks watch the crossing, and a harbour relay ties them together.

shots.prompt: A coordinated military operation at a coastline: reconnaissance drones and aircraft above, tanks and armoured vehicles on the beach, frigates and landing craft offshore, all moving together toward one objective, sunrise, heroic composition.
shots.line: A straight assault will leave you stranded between land and sea. Build every branch of your command together.

shots.prompt: Portrait of a fictional Turkish army colonel in his fifties, short grey hair and moustache, green camouflage uniform, headset, standing at a coastal command post with the sea behind him, confident and calm, looking at the viewer, cinematic rim light, painted portrait.
shots.line: Recon above. Armour ashore. Ships along the crossing. Then we go.

shots.prompt: Amphibious assault at dawn: landing craft reaching a rocky beach under covering fire from frigates, tanks rolling off the ramps, helicopters overhead, spray and smoke, dynamic and dramatic.
shots.line: This operation is a lesson in making the whole army matter.

shots.prompt: A captured harbour relay tower on a hill at sunset with friendly vehicles around it, the calm strait behind, smoke drifting, quiet victory.
